# PairUX - Collaborative Screen Sharing with Remote Control

> Real-time screen sharing with simultaneous remote mouse and keyboard control. Like Screenhero, but open source.

PairUX is an open-source desktop application for collaborative screen sharing with simultaneous remote mouse and keyboard control. Built on WebRTC (DTLS-SRTP), it delivers end-to-end encrypted P2P and SFU relay connections. Viewers can join from any modern browser — no install required.

Made by Profullstack, Inc. Contact: hello@pairux.com

## Pricing Summary

- **Free** ($0/forever): 2 participants + 5 viewers, P2P, screen sharing, remote control, E2E encryption, community support
- **Pro** ($12/month): 10 participants + 50 viewers, 100 viewer-hours/month included, SFU relay, HD 1080p, priority support
- **Team** ($49/month): Unlimited participants, 500 viewer-hours/month included, dedicated SFU, 4K screen sharing, admin controls

Overage rates: $0.08/hr (720p), $0.12/hr (1080p), $0.20/hr (4K).

## Key Differentiators

- Open source under MIT license — fully auditable at github.com/profullstack/pairux.com
- No per-seat pricing — flat rate per team, 40-70% cheaper than Zoom/Teams
- End-to-end encrypted — WebRTC DTLS-SRTP, media never touches our servers
- Simultaneous input — host and viewer can control the screen at the same time
- PWA viewer — no install required for viewers, any modern browser works
- Cross-platform desktop apps — macOS, Windows, Linux

## Install Methods

Homebrew, WinGet, Scoop, Chocolatey, AUR, APT, RPM, Gentoo, Nix, and direct download.
Shell: `curl -fsSL https://installer.pairux.com/install.sh | bash`
